user_1789032923971.title: 4-Week Intermediate Fat loss & conditioning Overload Program
user_1789032923971.daysPerWeek: 6 days a week - Push, Pull, Legs x 2
user_1789032923971.coachVerdict: Engineered for maximum sustainable progression with 4 complete training days per week and 6 structured exercises each session. By controlling weekly volume and peaking safely before a planned deload, you stimulate steady hypertrophy without joint inflammation.
progressionRules: The Double Progression Rule: Do not add weight until you hit the top rep target on all prescribed working sets with strict form.
Control the Negative: Maintain a 2-second lowering phase on every repetition to maximize time-under-tension and prevent tendon strain.
Deload Discipline: Respect Week 4 recovery to allow central nervous system supercompensation for the subsequent cycle.

weeks.progressionNote: Calibrate starting working weights. Focus on 2-second lowering and clean execution at RPE 7.5.

days.focus: Chest Pressing, Deltoid Width & Tricep Hypertrophy
days.warmup: 5 mins band pull-aparts, arm circles, and push-up activation.
days.cooldown: 3 mins doorway chest stretch and tricep overhead stretch.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.progressionRule: When you can hit 10 reps on all sets, add 2.5kg load next week.
coachingTips: Tuck shoulder blades back and down into the bench.
Keep forearms vertical and control the negative descent.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.progressionRule: Increase reps from 10 to 12 before moving up dumbbell size.
coachingTips: Set bench to 30 degrees to maximize upper chest activation.
Drive through palms and squeeze chest at the top.

exercises.name: Overhead Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.progressionRule: Progress reps to 12 with strict tempo before adding load.
coachingTips: Keep core clamped tight, avoid arching lower spine.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raises
exercises.progressionRule: Focus on 1-second squeeze at top horizontal plane.
coachingTips: Lead with elbows and avoid swinging torso.

exercises.name: Cable Tricep Rope Pushdowns
exercises.progressionRule: Spread rope handles apart at bottom for full contraction.
coachingTips: Pin elbows tight to ribs; isolate forearm extension.

exercises.name: Forearm Plank with Glute Squeeze
exercises.progressionRule: Increase plank hold time by 5 seconds each week.
coachingTips: Pull navel toward spine and maintain rigid neutral line.

days.focus: Lat Width, Mid-Back Thickness & Bicep Peak
days.warmup: 5 mins cat-cow, thoracic rotations, and dead hangs.
days.cooldown: 3 mins lat stretch and bicep wall stretch.

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown
exercises.progressionRule: Drive elbows into back pockets; add 1 rep per set weekly.
coachingTips: Depress shoulder blades before pulling.
Squeeze lats hard at upper chest level.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row (Neutral Grip)
exercises.progressionRule: Hold 1 second at peak contraction without leaning torso.
coachingTips: Pull handle towards lower ribs, keeping chest puffed out.

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.progressionRule: Step up dumbbell weight when hitting 12 clean reps.
coachingTips: Keep back parallel to ground or firmly against bench pad.

exercises.name: Cable Face Pulls with External Rotation
exercises.progressionRule: Prioritize strict rear delt contraction over heavy weight.
coachingTips: Pull rope toward bridge of nose; pull thumbs backward.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Bicep Curls
exercises.progressionRule: Emphasize deep stretch at bottom of each repetition.
coachingTips: Keep elbows behind torso; avoid swinging dumbbells.

exercises.name: Standing Hammer Curls
exercises.progressionRule: Keep palms facing inward throughout the movement.
coachingTips: Slow 2-second negative lowering on every rep.

days.warmup: 5 mins world’s greatest stretch, bodyweight squats, and ankle circles.
days.cooldown: 4 mins kneeling hip flexor stretch and hamstring sweep.

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat / Leg Press
exercises.progressionRule: Prioritize depth and mid-foot balance before increasing load.
coachingTips: Inhale into stomach to create 360-degree intra-abdominal pressure.
Drive through mid-foot and spread the floor with your feet.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift (Dumbbell or Barbell)
exercises.progressionRule: Add 2.5kg once 12 clean reps are completed with zero back rounding.
coachingTips: Hinge hips backward as if touching wall behind you.
Keep weights skimming close along your shins.

exercises.name: Walking Dumbbell Lunges
exercises.progressionRule: Increase 1 rep per leg weekly.
coachingTips: Keep torso slightly inclined forward for optimal glute loading.

exercises.name: Leg Extensions / Goblet Squat Hold
exercises.progressionRule: Pause 1 second at top contraction.
coachingTips: Controlled 2-second eccentric lowering on every repetition.

exercises.name: Standing Dumbbell Calf Raises
exercises.progressionRule: Pause 2 seconds at deep stretch, rise high on big toes.
coachingTips: Zero bouncing; slow rhythmic calf pump.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raises / Bicycle Crunches
exercises.progressionRule: Curl pelvis upward toward ribcage at top of motion.
coachingTips: Avoid swinging; use pure abdominal tension.

days.focus: Incline Pressing, Arm Growth & Core Stabilization
days.warmup: 5 mins light cardio, shoulder dislocates, and light lateral raises.
days.cooldown: 3 mins chest and shoulder recovery stretch.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.progressionRule: Add 1 rep each session; step up weight when reaching 10 reps.
coachingTips: Press upward and inward without clacking dumbbells together.

exercises.name: Neutral-Grip Lat Pulldown / Cable Row
exercises.progressionRule: Pause at bottom for full lat contraction.
coachingTips: Keep chest arched slightly toward ceiling.

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raises / Upright Rows
exercises.progressionRule: Add 1 rep per week with strict form.
coachingTips: Cable at wrist height, pull out toward side wall.

exercises.name: Ez-Bar / Dumbbell Bicep Curls
exercises.progressionRule: Strict form; zero body momentum.
coachingTips: Supinate wrists at top of curl.

exercises.name: Overhead Dumbbell Tricep Extension
exercises.progressionRule: Lower dumbbell behind head for full tricep stretch.
coachingTips: Keep elbows tucked in close to ears.

exercises.name: Forearm Plank with Knee Tucks
exercises.progressionRule: Increase total hold time by 5 seconds weekly.
coachingTips: Draw knee toward elbow without lifting hips.
